name: harness
description: The harness's judging plugin, beside the desk (harness-design.md §4.4, §6; #3490): the shipped command hooks, PreToolUse → xtask permit, Stop → xtask done --hook, SessionStart wiring the clone and rendering the local file, in hooks/hooks.json, a person's file; and the function-hook module beside them, judging each Edit, Write and Bash through xtask permit before the command hook does, the map and the local facts as a context block that names this session, refreshed after a Bash call that ran an instrument; userConfig functionHook false leaves the command hooks alone. Enabled by .claude/settings.json as harness@dax-php from the repository's own marketplace.
